title: Love this app!
body:
A while back I decide to start teaching my kids about important of habits and their impact on our life, this app have all what you need to create a custom habit, or use from list of most often used.

One suggestion for me personally is music icon, as I am learning play guitar, and I think it is more people who are also learning to play instruments.
author: Serhii Orlenko

title: Damn that’s simple and good
body: As the title said it’s simple and good, moreover it’s the only app i managed to find with no limits(or not too strict limits, i don’t exactly know how many, but it’s more than 5 available habits for sure )
author: Redmixes
